material.description: scenarios/moba/units_heroes.osd declares 127 heroes; 70 carry a model= and 57 do not. A hero with no model is not in the lobby pick list (roster_names filters on model ~= ""), so the roster offers 70. Counted against the 907 GLBs in scenarios/moba/assets/models. Blocking fact: models are generated by the hy3d studio route, whose remaining quota is 39 generations against 57 heroes. Witness: the model count per hero in units_heroes.osd against assets/models.

notes.note: Stale claim, verified on origin/main: units_heroes.osd has 127 hero rows with model=, all 127 names resolve to files in scenarios/moba/assets/models, 0 use a character-* placeholder (checked with git show origin/main). The working copy of units_heroes.osd carries an uncommitted edit by another lane, so a witness on that copy is not the gate. Close on a witness of origin after that lane's commit lands.

material.subject: 57 of 127 heroes have no model, so they are absent from the pick list
material.witness: Status: stale. Witness on origin/main 4162763f (verify-content-heroes-models-missing, dispatch 1792893827436-6362-c9c4161d70bcd7af): units_heroes.osd has 127 unit lines, all carry model=, 0 use character-*, all 127 resolve to scenarios/moba/assets/models stems; map.osd has 41 pillar lines. The 57-without-model claim is refuted.
